about:
Resco Products Inc. was founded in 1976 in Moulton, Alabama, as a privately owned refractory manufacturer. The company began as a supplier of high-temperature materials for heavy industry and has since expanded into a global provider of refractory solutions.

Resco manufactures a full line of refractory products including brick, clay-alumina castables, gun mixes, magnesia-based specialties, mortars, plastics, and precast shapes. Its capabilities encompass custom refractory design, engineering support, and extensive testing of mechanical, physical, and high-temperature properties. The company operates an experienced engineering department backed by state-of-the-art equipment to develop tailored solutions for demanding applications.

Resco serves major industries such as steel, copper, nickel, aluminum, hydrocarbon processing, cement, and lime production. Concrete applications include steel ladles, cement kilns, copper and nickel smelting, CO boilers, and ferro alloy furnaces. The company also supports nonferrous metals and petrochemical sectors with specialized refractory linings.

Resco emphasizes its people as its core strength, citing their knowledge base, experience, and dedication to customer service as the foundation of its mission. The company highlights unparalleled refractory applications expertise, value-added solutions, individually inspected products, and a commitment to innovation that aims to decrease downtime and increase yield volumes for customers. In January 2025, Resco joined forces with RHI Magnesita, becoming part of the global refractory leader.
